links.comparator_used: baseline prompts without clinically relevant facial feature information
links.outcome: Precision, recall and withdrawal rate for neonatal pain assessment from facial images
links.effect: Facial-feature prompts reached precision 100% with recall 40.1% and significantly reduced withdrawal rates versus baseline prompts. The latent-knowledge prompts reached precision 82.3% and recall 73.2%.
links.tradeoff: Recall was much lower (40.1%) with the facial-feature prompts than with the latent-knowledge prompts (73.2%).
links.quote: When instructed with specific criteria and facial features, it achieved high precision with significantly reduced withdrawal rates compared to baseline prompts, highlighting the feasibility of this novel approach as a real-world evaluation of state-of-the-art technology through all its steps of development.
